text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I started as a trainer here at Tracen
Academy only a few days ago.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's peaceful watching the students
practice while I fantasize about my
own
glorious days to come...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm hopeful that I'll soon become
someone's trainer, and help them
grow
into an excellent racer. That is, until...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: URRRAAAGH! OUTTA MY WAY!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Huff... pant... Crud... Where are ya?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Barnacles! I don't see 'em! I'm positive my
Golshi Radar was pinging in
this direction...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Radar alert... Radar alert... Trainer signal detected.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
No doubt—that's a radar ping, all right!
There's a trainer somewhere
close by!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
But... where? If I remember right, trainers
are green creatures with
big, pointy
fangs...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ah-ha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I make eye contact with the oddball
student... I've got a bad feeling
about this.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey, you there. You're a trainer, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Whaddya mean? You're wearing a
trainer badge, so that makes
you a trainer,
doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Geez, you need to quit the nonsense. You
might get kidnapped by
students looking
to be scouted...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—Students like me! The esteemed Gold
Ship!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Resistance is futile! No way I'm letting a
wild trainer run free!
RAAAGH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The one who calls herself Gold Ship is
getting way too close! This
could be
dangerous!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I might be in actual danger—I'd better get
out of here, fast!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ah! Hey, you! Hold it right there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I manage to escape behind the main hall.
It seems I've lost her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: What was that all about?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Excuse me... Are you all right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You're quite out of breath. Did something
happen?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, Gold Ship was?! Well, how
should I put this... You have my

sympathies.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I have to ask—how is it that you found
yourself in such a
predicament?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That makes sense... You see, she has a
strong desire to debut and
start racing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Having a trainer is an essential step to
running in official races.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship, however, hasn't found one yet.
Or rather... how should I
put this? She
can't hold on to one.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, in her efforts to find a trainer,
she's likely resorted to trying
to kidnap
one...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems like Gold Ship is a real
troublemaker around the school.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She seriously wants to race, which is great
and all, but I can't imagine
I'd be able to
handle her...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: URAAAAGH! Where's that wild trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh no... I think she's caught up to you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I can't get embroiled in this mess, so you'll
have to pardon me. Do try
your best to
stay safe!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: GRAAAAAARGH! Where are you?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not good! I gotta make a break for it! I
hope she doesn't see me...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oho! A wild trainer appears! ♪

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: You're mine now—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Swoosh!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Woohoooo! A successful hunt!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Aww, don't wuss out on me now. It's not
like I caught you to fill my
belly or
anything.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I'm just gonna take you on a
teensy-weensy, kinda-huge adventure.

Now that you're caught up on the details,
all aboard!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Still crammed in a bag, I get carried off to
who knows where...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Several hours later...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ding ding! What a day! Bright an' shiny!
This is the perfect weather to
search for
treasure!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Okey dokey, Golshi's super... exciting...
awesome treasure hunt
begins... NOW!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: What the... Where am I?! To be continued
